contract: Product: Sheggar Wheels — an Addis Ababa peer-to-peer car rental marketplace. Job: let a renter find a nearby car quickly while giving owners a clear path to list. Primary action: Browse cars, reinforced by the hero search. Hierarchy: sticky shadcnblocks Navbar1 (brand, Home/Browse Cars/Fleet/Renters/Owners menus, Sign In + Get Started) -> headline and perspective car corridor -> neighbourhood/type search -> featured fleet -> three-step explanation -> owner CTA -> footer. Target viewports: 390x844 and 1440x900. Reference: the zen-linen shadcn theme (21st.dev/@serafimcloud/themes/zen-linen) applied across every route — warm linen background #E9E4D8, cream cards #F4EFE4, charcoal primary #2E2E2E, sand secondary, muted clay accents, 0.5rem radius — with Roboto as the sole typeface and the shadcnblocks Navbar1 component as the site navigation.

theme.name: zen-linen
theme.coverage: All routes: layout shell (Navbar1, footer), landing page, /cars, /cars/[id], /dashboard, /checkout, /owner, /owner/cars/new, /admin, /signin, /signup. Hardcoded blue/gray/white utility classes on interior pages were mapped to theme tokens (bg-primary, bg-card, border-input, text-muted-foreground, etc.).

accessibility.evidence: Verified in rendered Chromium at both target viewports: computed body color rgb(46,46,46) on rgb(233,228,216) = 10.1:1 contrast; nav muted text rgb(93,87,70) on linen = 5.9:1; both hero selects keep sr-only labels; mobile menu button has aria-label 'Open menu'; the Fleet/Renters/Owners dropdowns and the mobile Sheet accordion are keyboard-operable Radix primitives; zero console or page errors on all five captured routes; zero horizontal overflow everywhere.

responsive.evidence: Measured scrollWidth-clientWidth = 0px on /, /cars, /dashboard, /signin at 390x844 and 1440x900. Desktop shows the horizontal NavigationMenu with hover dropdown; below lg the navbar collapses to the logo + Sheet trigger and the drawer stacks menu accordions, extra links in a 2-col grid, and both auth buttons. Landing hero search stacks to two selects plus a full-width Find a car button.

functional.evidence: Hero search with Bole + SUV navigates to /cars?neighbourhood=Bole&category=SUV and renders '2 cars available'. Fleet dropdown shows category links; /cars reads and applies query params. Production build (next build) compiles all 13 routes; tsc --noEmit clean.
